digest.component_or_area: bridge state storage and format versioning
propositions: Three committed-format changes to .bridge_state (A2 last_get_pass relocation, A3 scalar baseline normalization, A4-2 prev_snapshot narrowing) plus A1 baseline_advanced_at field deletion require an ADR documenting mixed-version protocol and rollback boundaries.
Bridge state remains committed on the tickets branch because ephemeral GitHub runners require durable state and off-branch relocation was rejected in epic 6c9c.

Mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) on reads and dual writes, then stops legacy writes after direct deployment evidence; first-wins is unsafe because legacy writes would race writes.

A2-2 cutover gate requires A2-1 merged to main, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle; elapsed time is insufficient without executable/source recording.

Each format change has distinct rollback boundaries: A2-1 reversible, A3 reversible through idempotent canonicalization, A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer, A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Measured storage reduction from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1, with 218/399 identical prev_snapshot key sets, documented in session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.
